title: Wanderlane Traveller Club Standing and the Agency Service Fee Returned on Air Ticket Fare Brands
content:
**Air Ticket Fare Brands — Wanderlane Traveller Club standing and the agency service fee.**

1. What comes back of the agency service fee on an air booking the traveller has given up follows the traveller club card the traveller holds. The standing read is the Wanderlane Traveller Club card standing on the traveller's profile: its tier, and whether the card is active.

2. Where the traveller holds an active traveller club card of the Platinum, Titanium or Ambassador tiers, the agency service fee of the fare brand held is returned for each traveller on the booking, at a share of 1.00, and added to the amount returned.

3. Where the traveller holds an active traveller club card of the Blue, Silver or Gold tiers, half the agency service fee of the fare brand held is returned for each traveller on the booking, at a share of 0.50, and added to the amount returned.

4. Otherwise nothing of the agency service fee is added to the amount returned.

| Active Wanderlane Traveller Club card standing on the profile | What is returned of the agency service fee of the fare brand held, for each traveller on the booking, and added in dollars to the amount returned |
| --- | --- |
| Platinum, Titanium or Ambassador | 1.00 |
| Blue, Silver or Gold | 0.50 |
| No active card of any of those tiers | nothing of the agency service fee is added to the amount returned |

5. The share is taken for each traveller on the booking and not once for the booking. On hypothetical figures: a booking carrying three travellers whose holder shows an active card of the Gold tier adds to the amount returned half the agency service fee of the fare brand held for each of the three travellers, at the share of 0.50; the same booking, with an active card of the Titanium tier, adds that agency service fee to the amount returned at the share of 1.00 for each of the three. Where the card standing on the profile is not active, nothing of the agency service fee is added to the amount returned, whatever tier the card names.
